hook: Jonathan Ho earned his PhD in electrical engineering and computer science at UC Berkeley, advised by Pieter Abbeel, working on generative models including GANs and normalizing flows. In 2020 he wrote Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models as lead author, a paper that showed diffusion based generative models could match the image quality of GANs. The DDPM formulation became the technical backbone behind Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 2 and Imagen. He later joined Google Research, where he co-authored Imagen and Video Diffusion Models, and in 2022 published Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance, a technique now standard in nearly every production text-to-image system.
name: Jonathan Ho
moniker: Lead author of the DDPM diffusion model paper

timeline.event: Publishes Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models with Ajay Jain and Pieter Abbeel
timeline.impact: Reestablished diffusion models as a competitive class of image generators.
Extended the diffusion framework from still images to video generation.
Applied diffusion models to large-scale text-to-image generation.

timeline.event: Publishes Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance with Tim Salimans
timeline.impact: Provided a simple guidance mechanism now used across diffusion-based image and video generators.

quick_facts: PhD in EECS from UC Berkeley, advised by Pieter Abbeel
Lead author of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (2020)
Co-authored Imagen, a text-to-image diffusion system, at Google Research
Introduced classifier-free guidance, a technique used across modern diffusion systems

achievements.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
achievements.impact: Showed that a simplified diffusion training objective could generate images competitive with GANs, becoming the technical foundation of Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 2 and Imagen.

achievements.title: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
achievements.impact: Introduced a way to trade off sample diversity for fidelity in diffusion models without a separate classifier, adopted as a default technique in production text-to-image systems.

achievements.title: Imagen and Video Diffusion Models
achievements.impact: Extended diffusion modeling from static images to text-to-image and video generation at Google Research.
